Subject: Pen test follow-up: current status and evidence request

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the pen test report delivery last month. We completed our internal review and have a handful of follow-up items where Acme's internal security team needs remediation status and (if available) evidence for closure. The items we care most about right now:

- AUTHZ-07: insufficient role enforcement for service-to-service API (identified privilege elevation via dev-only token).
- LOG-03: missing immutable request/response audit trail for admin-scope operations.
- NET-05: lateral access from management network to inference nodes during batch jobs.

Could you confirm:
1) Which findings are targeted for the current remediation sprint?
2) Owner and ETA for code fixes / infra changes (ideally with a test plan).
3) Whether you can provide a minimal evidence bundle (logs, config diffs, firewall rule snapshots) we can use for SOC 2 scoping.

We'd like an initial reply today or tomorrow — Acme's compliance team is gating production access to our pilot customers until we see closure for the three items above.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Lead Security Engineer — Acme Corp
acme-pt@acme.com

Samira — thanks for the clear list. Short version up front: we have an active sprint that covers AUTHZ-07 and LOG-03; NET-05 requires a small infra change and will be scheduled into the next maintenance window (ETA below). I attached a remediation matrix with owners and deliverables.

Summary (deltas vs. report):
- AUTHZ-07 (owner: Mina Haddad) — fix is in PR: service token scoping and runtime enforcement. We implemented token introspection and removed permissive dev roles from runtime image. QA + canary on dedicated infra planned this week. ETA for deployment to pilot: 2026-11-10 (can accelerate to 2026-11-08 with an emergency canary if you need earlier).

- LOG-03 (owner: Neha Kapoor) — immutable write-once audit stream implemented using our ingestion pipeline to S3 with server-side immutability flag + KMS-backed key rotation. We still need to wire admin UI events into the pipeline (small telemetry patch) and generate sample retention proof for SOC evidence. ETA: 2026-11-07 for sampling evidence.

- NET-05 (owner: Infra team / Karthik Iyer — cc'd on the remediation matrix) — requires tightening the management VPC route table and applying egress-only ACLs for the management subnet. This touches scheduled maintenance because changes affect internal burst capacity. Target maintenance: 2026-11-18. We can implement a partial mitigation (temporary host-based firewall rules) earlier if Acme wants the risk window shortened; that would be 2026-11-09.

Attachments: remediation_matrix_20261103.xlsx (owner tasks, test plans, and evidence buckets). I'm linking the Jira for the tickets as well.

I'll let Mina and Neha add technical specifics and evidence artifacts they plan to include. If you'd like a short sync with the owners tomorrow, we can set a 30-min slot.

— Vivek
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: current status and evidence request

Samira / team — technical update and concrete evidence plan for AUTHZ-07 and LOG-03.

AUTHZ-07 (detailed):
- Root cause: a legacy service account (svc/dev-ops) was minted with a broad role via an old CI job. That account was discoverable by attackers who could swap tokens during a staging-to-prod promotion.
- Fix implemented: CI job removed, token issuance flow rewritten to use short-lived ephemeral tokens (15m) with audience-bound claims. Runtime now validates aud+iat+nonce via token-introspection endpoint.
- Tests: unit tests added, integration test exercises token rotation under fault injection. Canary plan: 2 app nodes in dedicated pool, token-introspection latency tracked; health-check guard will rollback if >2% error.
- Evidence bundle we will provide: git diff of CI pipeline change, token-introspection access logs (redacted IPs), canary run report (stdout/gossip), and the related PR link. Expected evidence upload: 2026-11-06 16:00 UTC.

LOG-03 (detailed):
- Implementation: admin actions now write to an append-only shard in our audit S3 bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled (governance mode) and KMS CMK tied to our audit key policy. Ingestion pipeline emits a signed manifest per day.
- Remaining work: small telemetry connector to include admin UI request IDs. That is a config change (no code rollback risk).
- Evidence bundle: object-lock status snapshot, sample signed manifest, a snippet of the ingestion config commit, and a short runbook for retention policy. Expected evidence upload: 2026-11-07 12:00 UTC.

NET-05 (mitigation option):
- Temporary mitigation available: host-based iptables rule set applied to inference nodes to deny management-subnet ranges until full route ACL deployment. This is low-risk and reversible; ETA for deploy (if requested): 2026-11-09. Full network ACL route change remains scheduled for 2026-11-18.

I'll post the evidence bundle to the Drive link and attach the archive to this thread once uploaded. Let me know if you need hashes or time-stamped attestations for SOC auditors.

— Mina
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
